# Atelier West

> Atelier West is a 12-week, cash- and equity-free residency for Physical AI startups, based at Mission Rock in San Francisco. Cohort companies get lab access, expert mentorship from frog, Synapse, and Capgemini Experience Engineering, and a direct line to enterprise partners and investors via a closing Demo Day.

## Key facts
- Format: 12-week, in-person, cohort-based residency (about 5 companies per cohort)
- Cost: free for participants, no equity and no cash; a refundable deposit tied to lab access
- Location: Mission Rock, San Francisco, CA, with six labs (rapid prototyping, industrial design, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, metrology, new product introduction)
- Audience: Physical AI founders (robotics, autonomous machines, computer vision, edge AI devices) with traction
- Partner benefits: AWS for Startups credits
- Inaugural cohort: October 2026 to January 2027; applications close October 21, 2026
